invariants: grant programs bind to one Treasury budget and one Civic action commitment
program total cap and per-award cap are immutable for each program instance
applications use canonical domain-separated IDs and are immutable after submission
application submission is applicant-owned or narrowly capability-scoped and default-deny
awards can only target the applicant recorded by the accepted application
aggregate awards cannot exceed the program cap
aggregate milestone face value cannot exceed the award amount
milestone claims are recipient-owned or narrowly capability-scoped and default-deny
milestone approval requires an existing SCHEDULED Treasury disbursement with exact budget recipient amount Civic action and purpose matches
a milestone is PAID only after the bound Treasury disbursement is EXECUTED with a nonzero Vault release commitment
420Grants never holds or transfers treasury assets and cannot bypass Treasury caps or Vault custody
cancelling an unpaid grant object does not claw back already paid funds; recovery requires a separately authorized Treasury/Civic action
